prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean UV bed tanning or spray (airbrush/mist) tanning? Also which part of Charlotte or what ZIP code are you near (Uptown, South End, University area, Ballantyne, etc.)?

Quick guidance while you decide:
- If you want spray tans, look for salons that use trusted solutions (Norvell, Mystic) and offer a patch test and photos of before/afters. Read recent Yelp/Google reviews for consistency.
- If you want UV beds, prefer salons that maintain equipment well and list high-quality booth brands (Ergoline, KBL). Remember UV carries skin-cancer and premature-aging risks — check their hygiene and staff training.
- Chains with multiple Charlotte locations you’ll find easily: Palm Beach Tan, Sun Tan City, Planet Beach — they’re consistent and convenient; many people prefer local boutique salons for customized spray tans.
- What to ask when you call: technician experience, booth types/levels, solution brands, price for a first-time spray with shade recommendations, sanitation practices, and availability for a trial patch.

Tell me the neighborhood and whether you prefer spray or UV and I’ll recommend the top-rated salons in that area.
